initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a beautiful reusable, TEXT-FREE portrait stationery background for Cecilia's QQ illustrated cards, portrait 2:3.

Reference images: all four supplied images show the same girl. Reference 1 establishes Cecilia's face and everyday cream blouse/dark pinafore. Reference 2 establishes her light olive-green hair, golden green eyes, fine reddish lash lines, shy expression, and delicate hand-drawn marks. Reference 3 establishes the original illustration's thin confident contours, clear colored shadow shapes, flower accents, and warm natural light. Reference 4 establishes the same face, vivid gentle eyes and precise pastel linework. These are character-identity AND drawing-style references; match their distinctive look closely. They are not backgrounds to reproduce.

Draw a new, elegant stationery sheet with Cecilia as a small but expressive waist-up illustration in the TOP RIGHT, occupying roughly the rightmost 40% of the TOP 29% of the sheet. Her head and face remain fully visible and readable, looking gently toward the empty area, with a slight warm smile and quiet blush. Keep her actual light olive/sage-green long hair and golden-green eye color, hair grouping, eye shape and proportions from the references. Wear her simple cream high-collar blouse with a dark brown pinafore. Draw slim lively lines, asymmetric natural strands, small blush hatch marks, simple layered flat shadow shapes and restrained crisp highlights, closely matching the reference illustrations. The face should have distinct linework and character, not a generic round anime doll.

Layout: TOP LEFT is completely blank and suitable for a dynamic title. MIDDLE is a LARGE uninterrupted pale ivory writing area, approximately x=12–88%, y=34–82%, with almost uniform color and just barely visible paper texture. Both side margins within this middle band contain only a continuous very thin quiet sage border, so software can extend this blank band vertically without distorting any art. Keep ALL character art above y=30%. At the bottom corners, add only small hand-drawn white blossoms, a few sage leaves and one tiny muted coral flower, confined to the bottom 13%. Use lots of breathing space, a gentle storybook feeling, and a restrained illustrated stationery design. One subtle outer frame is enough. Overall warm ivory, sage-green and muted rose accents, tuned to the supplied girl.

Text: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, headings, signatures or watermark anywhere.
Avoid ornate gold filigree, large bows, densely packed flowers, interior boxes, shiny realistic petals, watercolor fog over the face, airbrushed plastic skin, 3D shading, silver hair, gray eyes, heavy bloom, extra characters, and decoration inside the writing area. The result should feel like stationery designed around the original Japanese comic illustration, with natural ink lines and clear shapes.
palette_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / palette refinement.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the text-free Cecilia stationery background just generated. Images 2–5 are supporting references of the same character, especially the original illustrations' bright whites, fresh light olive-green hair, golden-green eyes and clean pastel light.

Change the palette and paper atmosphere of Image 1 to feel fresh, luminous, youthful and close to the supplied original illustrations. The current yellow-brown parchment and muted olive ornament coloring looks aged; remove that vintage tint entirely.

Preserve the exact girl identity, face shape, eyes, expression, pose, location, thin hand-drawn linework and her cream blouse/dark pinafore. Preserve the overall composition, empty title area at top left, very large uninterrupted text area in the middle, delicate outer frame and small blossom decorations at the edges. Do not add any objects, boxes or writing.

Specific palette changes:
- Main writing paper: nearly white with a tiny gentle milk-white tint, like fresh high-quality stationery, not yellow ivory or beige parchment. Very smooth and quiet, no visibly aged fibers, mottling, brown stains or yellow gradient.
- Character: fresh light sage/olive green hair with clean pale highlights; clear golden-green eyes, fresh pink blush and whites that remain luminous. Keep depth in the original-style flat shadow shapes. Avoid blanket desaturation, grayscale hair, amber fog and orange filtering.
- Leaves and border: fresher light sage, soft mint and natural spring greens, replacing brownish khaki/olive. White blossoms with small light peach-pink centers, tiny soft pink accent buds. Keep flowers delicate and simple.
- Ambient decorative color near the upper corners: only very faint blush pink or pale mint, with a little clean airy white light. Remove the brown-yellow tree-shadow wash over the upper-left paper.
The whole sheet should feel like a bright, tender original Japanese comic illustration in spring daylight, light and clear rather than antique stationery. Avoid retro sepia, yellow haze, heavy bloom, yellow-gold ornament colors, highly saturated neon, dull gray and plastic skin.

ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, numbers, headings, watermarks or signatures. Keep the middle reading area clean and almost uniformly white so software can later typeset and extend it.
